state.startup_desc: RouteWise sells route-optimization software to mid-size delivery fleets, marketed primarily on fuel-cost and time savings. Reduced emissions are a secondary effect of more efficient routing, not the sales pitch.

Track A: Operational footprint.description: Cloud-hosted SaaS platform on AWS; a single office in Prague; no delivery fleet of our own.
Track A: Operational footprint.assumption: Cloud compute is the dominant driver of our own footprint, not office energy use.

Track A: Operational footprint.description: AWS compute and storage, plus office energy and commuting for 34 staff.
Track A: Operational footprint.assumption: AWS's reported carbon accounting reasonably reflects the actual regional grid mix behind our workloads.

Track A: Operational footprint.description: Estimated 42 t CO2e/year (cloud Scope 2 plus office Scope 1 and 2).

Track B: Product/service externalities.stage: Activities: product or service in the market
Track B: Product/service externalities.description: Route optimization reduces total distance driven and idle time for customer delivery fleets.
Track B: Product/service externalities.assumption: Drivers actually follow the optimized routes rather than overriding them with manual choices.

Track B: Product/service externalities.description: Customer fleets self-report roughly 9% lower fuel consumption per delivery after adoption.
Track B: Product/service externalities.assumption: Fuel savings are banked as a reduction, not spent on expanding delivery volume or service area (rebound effect).

Track B: Product/service externalities.description: Net fuel and emissions effect across the customer fleet base, after netting out any rebound-driven volume growth.

state.weakest_links: The rebound effect on Track B is unverified. Several of our largest customers have grown their delivery volume alongside adopting RouteWise, and we cannot yet separate 'lower emissions per delivery' from 'more total deliveries eating into that per-unit gain.'

Scope 2 indirect emissions (purchased el.pathway_link: Track A: Operational footprint → Impact: direct environmental effect

Avoided emissions vs. conventional refer.claim: Customer fleets report an average 9% reduction in fuel consumption per delivery after adopting RouteWise.
Avoided emissions vs. conventional refer.assumptions: Self-reported by 14 of 60 active customers; only 3 customers share raw telematics data for cross-check against the self-reported figure.
Avoided emissions vs. conventional refer.conditions: True figure could be lower if only satisfied customers respond to the survey (self-selection bias), or the telematics-verified subset could be unrepresentative of the wider customer base either way.

state.review_notes: Get telematics-verified fuel savings data from more than 3 customers before the next review, and investigate the rebound effect against delivery-volume growth.
